setup: Controller selected as MIDI input; individually selectable input channel.
action: Enable controller MPE mode.
expected: Track input is All Channels; individual channel selection unavailable.
comparator: Compare selected channel and allowed channel choices; incoming MIDI handling outside this case.

setup: MIDI clip with notes made without MPE hardware; Note Expression closed.
action: Open Note Expression with tab or Alt/Option+3.
expected: Pitch overlay and Slide/Pressure/Velocity/Release Velocity controls accessible; Slide/Pressure default-visible.
comparator: Compare dimension names and visibility in an uncustomized view; optional Pitch lane U.

setup: No expression lanes enabled.
action: Click triangle, then hide; Alt/Option-click triangle; resize one lane then total split.
expected: All lanes shown from empty state; visibility toggles hide with lanes; resizing affects selected lane or total group.

setup: Two notes with distinct Pressure envelopes.
action: Select first note then its Pressure envelope.
expected: First note/curve editable and highlighted; second dimmed; background drag defines selection.
comparator: Compare selected-note identity and editable breakpoint set.

setup: Pressure envelope has points at local beats 0.25 and 0.75 with values 20 and 40.
action: Click middle segment, delete added point by click; choose Edit Value on first and enter 30.
expected: One point added then removed; edited point displays 30.
comparator: Compare point count changes +1/-1 and final entered value; numeric rounding beyond these integers U.

setup: One note, interior Pressure points at 0.25/0.5/0.75; middle time region selected.
action: Drag middle segment vertically; Shift-drag a selected point horizontally.
expected: Segment region gets edge breakpoints and moves together; Shift restricts axis.
comparator: Compare edge-point presence and unchanged perpendicular coordinates; drag thresholds/clipping U.

setup: Note Expression grid off, Notes-tab grid on.

expected: Expression grid independent of other tab and saved with clip.

setup: Straight interior Pressure segment.
action: Alt/Option-drag segment then Alt/Option-double-click.
expected: Curve becomes curved, then straight.
comparator: Compare curve/straight visual state only; numerical sample interpolation U.

action: Scale via outside-note hover gesture; separately select all points and move vertically.
expected: First adjusts proportionally; second moves all chosen values equally; Pitch lacks proportional gesture.
comparator: Compare relative versus equal movement of nonzero values; scale amount/origin and clipping U.

setup: Note starts at beat 1, duration 2; expression local points 0.5 and 1.5.

expected: Move carries expression +2 beats in clip time; stretch carries expression timing with doubled note.
comparator: Compare +2 absolute time translation; stretch corresponding interior times 1 and 3 relative to new note start; exact endpoints U.

expected: Pitch snaps to nearest semitone; zoom includes selected bends.

setup: Two selected notes with Pressure and Slide, third unselected.

expected: Selected notes expression envelopes clear.

setup: Note Expression Pitch/Pressure/Slide target and visible one-quarter-beat grid.

expected: Grid drawing creates steps at visible grid width; holding B temporarily toggles Draw Mode.
